# Tic-tac-toe Rule Snapshot

Source: Invent with Python, Tic-tac-toe clone.

Rules abstracted for VQA generation:
- Played on a 3x3 grid.
- Players (X and O) take turns placing their marks.
- A player wins by aligning three marks horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.

VQA Questions:
- Determine if X or O has already won.
- Identify the coordinates where X should play to win immediately.
